editionData.description: Global headlines: Gas prices are about to take a big jump, analysts say, with the worst still to come (The forecast of economic impacts beyond November’s midterms contrast with the Trump administration’s optimistic messaging); StarKist’s tuna supply chain partly relies on forced labor, report finds (Workers allege involuntary labor and other abuses on Taiwan-flagged fishing boats that supply the U.S. brand, according to a report by Global Labor Justice); and U.S. denies visas to Palestinian officials ahead of U.N. General Assembly (It is the second consecutive year the State Department has prevented key Palestinian officials from attending the U.N. meeting in New York). Markets leaned higher, with 6 of 7 tracked indexes up; NASDAQ Composite up 1.69% was the largest move. Benchmarks tracked: S&P 500, NASDAQ Composite, Euronext 100 Index, and Public Joint-Stock Company Moscow Exchange MICEX-RTS plus 3 more indexes. Hacker News: Hacking OpenAI (A heap overflow and SSO misconfiguration to compromise OpenAI internal repositories); Jemalloc 5.4.0 (This release contains over 160 commits, focusing on the technical debts cleaning including refactorings, bug fixes, test coverage...); and Astra for Law (OpenAI for Law brings frontier intelligence for law, custom firm workflows, connected legal data sources, and legal-grade controls for...). Product Hunt features Mola (Build your café, hire a team, and grow a coffee chain), Polishory (Get a clear plan to improve your website and prevent AI slop), and Foleyfy (Turn everyday sounds into game-ready sound packs).

headlines.title: The driver who slammed into an LA bus before helicopter crash is charged with murder
headlines.summary: An SUV driver was under the influence of drugs when she swerved into the wrong lane, blew a red light and slammed into a Los Angeles city bus, killing two riders, prosecutors said as they charged her with murder.

headlines.title: Trump withdraws Lance Schroyer, a former Oklahoma state trooper, as his nominee to lead ICE
headlines.summary: The White House says it is withdrawing its nomination of Lance Schroyer, a former Oklahoma state trooper, to lead ICE, ensuring that an agency at the forefront of President Trump's domestic agenda will remain without a Senate-confirmed leader for at least a while longer.

headlines.title: ICE agent appears in Minnesota court to face charges in the shooting of a Venezuelan immigrant
headlines.summary: Christian Castro, a federal immigration officer, made his first court appearance in Minnesota since he was booked Wednesday into a local jail. Castro faces multiple state and federal charges in connection with a shooting during the immigration surge in Minnesota.

headlines.title: Retired Olympic superstar Jessie Diggins wins her first-ever 100 mile trail race
headlines.summary: This spring Jessie Diggins retired as one of America's most successful winter Olympic athletes at age 34. She's relaxing by entering 100-mile trail running races and navigating what comes next.

headlines.title: To prevent deaths in childbirth, Kenyan moms turn to an AI powered chatbot
headlines.summary: Many questions come up during pregnancy. Is swelling normal? Are avocados safe to eat? For folks in Kenya who don't have a search engine at their fingertips, a chatbot is offering a lifeline.

headlines.title: Carney welcomes EU's associate membership
headlines.summary: BRUSSELS — Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on Thursday welcomed a proposal for his country to become the European Union's first "associate member", shrugging off threats from US President Donald Trump.

headlines.title: Fed raises rate for 1st time since 2023
headlines.summary: The US Federal Reserve raised its benchmark interest rate on Wednesday by a quarter of a percentage point, the first rise since 2023, as the central bank's new Chairman Kevin Warsh led a decisive move to tackle stubborn inflation, defying President Donald Trump's repeated calls for a rate cut.

headlines.title: Hostilities take heavy toll on Yemeni civilians: UN
headlines.summary: UNITED NATIONS - Hostilities spreading across Yemen are taking a devastating toll on struggling families, and relief agencies are ramping up aid for refugees arriving in Djibouti, UN humanitarians said on Thursday.

headlines.title: Jordan looks to cooperation with China on green energy
headlines.summary: China and Jordan have stepped up their efforts to deepen cooperation in fields such as green energy as the recent visit by Jordan's King Abdullah II to China opened new avenues for practical bilateral cooperation.

headlines.title: Sept 18 memories back in focus
headlines.summary: Friday marks the 95th anniversary of the September 18th Incident. Chinese and European political commentators and peace advocates have called for the lessons of history to be remembered amid mounting concerns over Japan's expanding military capabilities and a deteriorating regional security environment.
